name: pam_keyinit
detailed_description: Session module that initializes the user's kernel keyring and ensures proper key setup for session-specific cryptographic operations. Particularly important for login sessions and services that require kernel key management.

parameters.revoke_all_on_logout: Revoke all keys when session ends
parameters.user_keyring: Revoke user keyring instead of session

notes:
Initializes kernel keyring for session; important for systemd-based login sessions and cryptographic operations.
